name: Himitsu no Hanazono
source:
Ayako lives with her mother after the accident that took her father's life.
Her mother and her were in very good terms, and their relationship was more like a that of sisters.
However, one day, Ayako could no longer withhold her thought that she had been kept deep in her heart.

This is a visual novel on the theme of lesbian bondage.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE057714.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
有栖川绫子的父亲在意外中丧生，此后她便与母亲相依为命。
母女二人感情极好，相处时更像一对姐妹。
然而某天，绫子再也无法压抑那个深藏心底的念头。

本作是一部以女同性恋束缚为主题的视觉小说。
